**💰Salary Based On Your Experience And Seniority Level

**🇩🇰Up to 48,000 DKK (gross)

**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Mid Level Backend Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Power the #1 CPMS & EV charging Platform: Build the robust, scalable infrastructure necessary to make Monta the undisputed global leader in Charge Point Management Systems.

• Scale the Roaming Network: Strengthen our existing roaming functionality. Your work will directly impact how seamlessly thousands of EV drivers connect to charging points across different networks.

• Innovate on Standards: Implement exciting new features including the latest OCPI versions and Plug & Charge capabilities.

• Turn vision into reality: Balance technical ambition with sleeves-rolled-up execution to ensure our fleet and roaming offerings remain best-in-class.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own the full lifecycle: Scope out requirements and plan new features in collaboration with the team, taking code from ideation to production.

• Cross-team execution: Work closely with Roaming Ops, Product, Frontend and other Backend teams to navigate ambiguity and ensure features integrate seamlessly.

• Ensure quality at speed: Perform automated validation and verification testing while supporting your teammates with thoughtful code reviews.

• Monitor and Maintain: Utilize tools like Grafana and Loki to monitor system health, ensuring reliability for the drivers who depend on us.

• Own outcomes in a high-trust environment where we value execution over perfection.

• Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities keeping momentum when it matters most.

• Celebrate wins and learn fast from misses alongside an ambitious, diverse team.

• Push boundaries with courage and resilience while staying true to our DNA.

**A Brief Overview Of Our Tech Stack

**

• PHP/Laravel monolith

• Kotlin services with Micronaut and Exposed

• Dart/Flutter (incl. Flutter Web) for apps

• Typescript/React (+Next.js) for web apps and rapid prototyping

• Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• AWS + Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD for deployments

What We’re Looking For

• Junior ready for the next jump or mid-level backend experience: You have experience building scalable backend systems.

• Tech Stack: You have worked in Kotlin (Micronaut) and PHP (Laravel), or have experience in one with the ability to quickly master the other in a mixed environment.

• Clear & pragmatic communicator who builds alignment fast.

• Authentic team player with empathy, openness, and ownership.

• Comfortable with AI-powered tools to accelerate your work (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.), with the willingness to learn more.

_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

_**AI Competency

**You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

_We don’t expect mastery of all, but we expect comfort with learning, experimenting, and adopting AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• Becoming number one is not easy — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

jobs.occupation: 3-year PhD Position in CRISPR-Based Genome Editing
jobs.description:
Applications are invited for a full-time, 3-year PhD position in CRISPR-based genome editing, with a preferred starting date of 1st of January 2027.

The Research Group

The project will be conducted in the research group led by Chief Physician Maria Rossing at MDxCore, Rigshospitalet, and is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Our group consists of six dedicated researchers working within genomic medicine and translational research. We offer a collaborative research environment and excellent facilities in modern laboratories at Rigshospitalet.

Project Details

CRISPR-based genome editing offers the potential to correct disease-causing genetic variants at their source. Recent clinical successes demonstrate that precise, patient-specific genome editing is feasible, but such approaches remain exceptional and have not yet been translated into systematic therapeutic pipelines for rare disorders. This project aims to develop a patient-tailored CRISPR-based therapy for Glanzmann thrombasthenia, a severe inherited bleeding disorder caused by defects in platelet integrin αIIbβ3. Focusing on pathogenic patient variants in the ITGA2B gene, we will establish a translational workflow spanning characterization of the genetic defect, development of relevant cellular models, optimization of genome-editing strategies, and assessment of functional rescue and editing safety. The most promising strategy will be evaluated in hematopoietic stem cells and preclinical models to assess efficacy, durability, and safety. The project will thereby establish a framework for translating individualized genome editing into potential therapies for rare genetic disorders.

Application deadline: 30st of November 2026, 23:59 CET

Preferred start date: 1st of January 2027

Duration: 3 years

Requirements

We are seeking a highly motivated and ambitious scientist with the following qualifications:

• A master’s in medicine, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field, completed before the application deadline

• Experience in CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing and molecular and cell biology

• Experience with cell culture and relevant molecular and biochemical techniques

• Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary research team

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English

• A strong interest in translational research and the development of novel genome-editing therapies

Place of Employment

The position is based in the Rossing Research Group at MDxCore, Department of Clinical Biochemistry, Rigshospitalet – Copenhagen University Hospital, Copenhagen, Denmark. Rigshospitalet is one of Denmark's leading university hospitals and is located centrally in Copenhagen.

Terms of Employment

The position is a full-time, fixed-term appointment for three years. The average working week is 37 hours. Salary, pension, and other terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for employees in the Danish Regions.

Application

The application must be submitted electronically by clicking “Apply now” no later than 31st of November 2026 at 23:59 (Copenhagen local time).

The application must include the following documents in PDF format:

• Letter of motivation describing previous research experience, research interests, and career plans (maximum 1 page)

• CV including education, research/work experience, language skills, and other relevant skills

• Copy of Master's degree certificate

• Transcripts of relevant previous degrees

• List of publications

• Letter(s) of recommendation (optional)

Applications received by email or through other platforms cannot be accepted.

Recruitment Process

Eligible applicants will be assessed based on their CV, motivation letter, qualifications, and submitted documentation. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an on-site or online interview. All applicants will be notified once the recruitment process has been completed.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact:

Maria Rossing

Professor, Chief Physician

MDxCore, Department of Clinical Biochemistry

Rigshospitalet – Copenhagen University Hospital

caroline.maria.rossing@regionh.dk

_Are you skilled at turning financial information into a clear performance story? Can you move confidently from the detail behind the numbers to the insights that matter most? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment with senior stakeholder exposure?

_The Group FP&A function owns and steers the financial performance of Pandora. The function plays a vital role in defining and enforcing the global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance and within the business – including being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs and management reporting to the CFO and CEO. The function is therefore key to Pandora’s ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the capital markets.

As Senior Manager, FP&A Reporting, you will play a key role in Pandora’s Group performance reporting, translating financial results and underlying business drivers into clear, decision-relevant insights for the CFO and CEO.

You will play a key role in the end-to-end performance reporting cycle, turning performance trends and underlying drivers into sharp insights, recommendations and actions. Working closely with Group Reporting & Accounting, Group Commercial Finance and stakeholders across Pandora, you will combine strong financial foundations with sound business judgement to turn complexity into clarity.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously develop Pandora’s end-to-end Group performance reporting, including clear and decision-relevant commentary.

• Lead the preparation of the monthly and quarterly Group Business Performance Reviews and closing reviews delivering a high-quality reporting pack that clearly highlights key results, business drivers, risks and opportunities.

• Prepare executive and Board reporting, translating financial information into concise, actionable insights.

• Coordinate FP&A activities related to monthly, quarterly and annual closing in close partnership with Group Reporting & Accounting and other Finance teams.

• Analyze performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, including key drivers across revenue, gross margin, costs and cash flow.

• Play a key role in the governance and reporting of like-for-like performance, including system logic and definitions, ensuring LFL is consistently applied as a key performance measure.

• Serve as the centre of excellence for Group reporting methodology and the management reporting package, ensuring one set of numbers

• Partner with our Global Cost Transformation office on reporting and follow-up of initiatives and financial benefits.

• Continuously improve the structure, content and quality of Group performance reporting and commentary, driving simplification, standardization and automation across reporting processes and ways of working.

**What We’re Looking For

**You are a business-minded finance professional with a strong technical foundations and the ability to turn detailed analysis into a compelling executive-level performance story.

**What You Bring

**

• Relevant experience from a similar role within Group Finance, FP&A or controlling in a larger international organization.

• A robust accounting foundation and a solid understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, including working capital.

• Experience with monthly closing, Group consolidation, management reporting and performance-review processes.

• Proven ability to translate financial results into clear, concise insights for CFO and/or Board-level audiences.

• Sound business acumen and judgement, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and focus on what matters most.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

• A proactive mindset, anticipating needs and raising issues and opportunities early rather than simply reacting to requests.

• A track record of improving, simplifying or automating finance and reporting processes, supported by advanced systems, Excel and PowerPoint skills.

• Comfort working in a complex international environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

**Additional Information

**

• Career Band 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued.

**The Impact You'll Make

**The future of Sales and Customer Service will not be built by simply digitizing today's processes - it will be shaped by people who rethink how work gets done.

As our Forward Deployed AI Solution Engineer, you'll work closely with Sales and Customer Service teams to identify high-impact opportunities and turn AI, automation, and digital technologies into practical solutions that improve how we work.

This role is for a curious problem-solver who enjoys challenging the status quo, experimenting with emerging technologies, and creating measurable business value. Your impact will be seen through improved productivity, better decision-making, stronger adoption, and enhanced experiences for employees and customers.

From AI copilots and intelligent automation to digital workflows and data-driven insights, you'll help shape the future of how Sales and Customer Service teams work at Danfoss Climate Solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Serve as the AI and Digital Transformation lead for your commercial domain (Sales or Customer Service), driving adoption of innovative technologies and new ways of working.

• Identify and deliver opportunities that reduce manual effort, simplify processes, increase productivity, and create better experiences for employees and customers.

• Inspire stakeholders by demonstrating what is possible with AI, helping teams move from experimentation to business value.

• Evaluate business impact by measuring adoption, efficiency gains, and user feedback, ensuring solutions deliver real value.

• Capture best practices and reusable solution patterns that help accelerate AI adoption across commercial functions.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Someone to constantly challenge "the way we've always done it" and help unlock entirely new ways of working through AI, automation, and data-driven decision making.

• At least 3 years of experience in sales or customer excellence, project management, solution engineering, technical consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI enablement, or a similar hands-on role.

• Experience working closely with business stakeholders and translating business problems into practical digital or AI-enabled solutions.

• Strong understanding of commercial processes such as sales operations, customer support, pricing, quotations, CRM, or product data management.

• An advantage if experience with modern digital technologies such as APIs, automation platforms, AI solutions, low-code tools, SQL, Python, or similar technologies.

• Strong analytical thinking, excellent English communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across business and engineering teams.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• Shape the future of commercial operational excellence by using AI and digital technologies to solve meaningful business challenges with real, measurable impact.

• Grow your career through continuous learning, exposure to emerging AI technologies, and collaboration with global experts across Sales, Customer Service, Digital, Data, and AI.

• Enjoy the autonomy to experiment, innovate, and bring your ideas to life in an environment that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

• Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, knowledge is shared, and teams succeed together across functions and borders.

• Receive the flexibility and support to do your best work, helping you balance professional growth with your wellbeing while making a meaningful difference.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Indian Tandoor Chef for Pippali Indian Grill

Pippali Indian Grill is looking for an experienced Indian Tandoor Chef to join our kitchen team.

Pippali Indian Grill is an Indian restaurant dedicated to serving authentic Indian cuisine with a strong focus on quality, flavour and traditional cooking techniques.

We are looking for a skilled, experienced and reliable Indian Tandoor Chef who specialises in traditional North Indian tandoori cooking, including preparing and cooking dishes in a clay tandoor oven.

As our new Tandoor Chef, you will be responsible for preparing authentic Indian tandoori specialities, including tandoori chicken, chicken tikka, seekh kebabs, naan, roti and other traditional vegetarian and non-vegetarian tandoori dishes. You will play an important role in maintaining the authenticity, consistency and high quality of our food.

Your main tasks will include:

• 
Preparing and cooking authentic North Indian tandoori dishes using a traditional clay tandoor oven

• 
Preparing and baking Indian breads, including naan, garlic naan, butter naan and tandoori roti

• 
Preparing traditional tandoori specialities such as chicken tikka, tandoori chicken, seekh kebabs, paneer tikka and other grilled dishes

• 
Preparing authentic Indian marinades, spice blends and seasoning mixtures

• 
Managing tandoor temperatures and ensuring proper cooking techniques

• 
Ensuring consistent food quality, flavour, texture and presentation

• 
Maintaining hygiene, food safety and cleanliness standards in the kitchen

• 
Assisting with daily kitchen preparation, ingredient handling and cleaning

• 
Cooperating with the kitchen team to ensure efficient service during busy periods

We expect that you:

• 
Have relevant culinary education or equivalent documented professional experience as a Tandoor Chef or Indian cook

• 
Have practical experience working with a traditional Indian clay tandoor oven, preferably in a professional Indian restaurant kitchen

• 
Have strong knowledge of authentic North Indian tandoori cuisine and traditional cooking methods

• 
Can independently prepare a wide range of tandoori dishes, kebabs and Indian breads

• 
Have experience preparing traditional marinades, spice blends and tandoori seasoning

•

jobs.occupation: Academic Coordinator for the EUROfusion Project
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one funded Academic Staff position, to be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. The temporary position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, until 31 December 2027. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Work environment

The candidate will be part of SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development, and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently about 24 researchers, engineers and PhD students, specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

Job description

The candidate will be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. Jointly, and together with the rest of the team around this project, this goes for other institutes and departments of SDU TEK together with partners from ITER and EUROfusion. 

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have the following qualifications:

• 
Good communication and collaborative skills

• 
Good English and Danish skills, both written and spoken

• 
Can work independently and have a good overview

• 
IT skills and being good at developing and maintaining procedures

• 
Background in engineering will be useful, e.g. involving handling of 3D models

Contact information

For further information, please contact Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: November 30, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Enjoy getting to the root of customer problems? Join PriceShape as Product Success Manager and turn data and product questions into clear, timely solutions.
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex product and data questions, helping customers get real value from a SaaS platform, and owning a case from start to finish? Then you might be the next addition to our Product Success Team at PriceShape.

At PriceShape, you’ll join an international SaaS company on a strong growth journey, where you’ll play a key role in making sure our existing customers succeed with our platform every day.

Your Role at PriceShape

As a Product Success Manager, you’ll support our existing customers and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) with product, data and technical questions. You’ll own every request from the moment it comes in until it is resolved or handed over with clear information and ownership.

Half of your time goes to product support: investigating issues, giving clear guidance and making sure each request reaches the right solution. The other half goes to commercial account handling: renewals, expansions, Business Reviews and spotting risks and opportunities in your accounts.

You’ll work closely with CSMs, Product Success colleagues, Solutions Engineers, Data Controllers, and our Product and Engineering teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

Product Success (approx. 50%)

• 
Handle product, data and technical questions from customers and CSMs with clarity, ownership and the right level of urgency.

• 
Investigate product configuration, product behaviour and data issues to find the cause and the right solution.

• 
Resolve requests on your own where you can, and work out whether a case is a product question, a data task or a product defect.

• 
Escalate complex data tasks to Data Controllers and product defects to Product or Engineering, with full context, examples and expected outcomes.

• 
Keep CSMs and customers updated on status, ownership and next steps.

• 
Turn recurring questions into better documentation, guidance and ways of working, and share insights with Product, Data and GTM.

Commercial Operations & Account Handling (approx. 50%)

• 
Proactively manage contract renewals, expansion plans and account upgrades in line with the account strategy.

• 
Prepare and run Business Reviews that show product value, ROI and fit with the customer’s strategic goals.

• 
Handle payment reminders and related account administration professionally.

• 
Document and escalate commercial risks and opportunities, such as churn threats or upsell potential seen in product usage.

What We’re Looking For

• 
Experience in a customer-facing role within B2B SaaS, such as product support, customer success, technical account management or similar.

• 
A strong analytical and technical mindset, and comfort working with data and complex product setups.

• 
The ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and internal teams.

• 
Commercial awareness, with experience in, or a strong interest in, renewals, upsell and Business Reviews.

• 
A structured way of working with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.

• 
Fluent English, both written and spoken.

• 
The ability to thrive in a collaborative and international environment.

What We Offer

• 
A fast-growing SaaS company with opportunities for personal and professional development.

• 
A collaborative and international team with a strong team spirit.

• 
A competitive salary package.

• 
Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work-life balance.

• 
A modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C with great facilities, an in-house canteen, and social activities.

• 
Pension and health insurance.

About PriceShape

PriceShape is a global leader in competitor monitoring and dynamic pricing. Our platform helps brands and online retailers track vendors’ prices, stock availability and trends while implementing tailored pricing strategies.

We’re a diverse team of 80 employees from 24 nationalities, working from a modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C. We prioritise work-life balance, trust, community and personal and professional growth.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please send us your CV and application as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

**Specialist, Lifecycle Programs - CRM focused

**Do you want to build customer journeys that engage customers across their lifecycle?

We are looking for a hands-on lifecycle professional to help Pandora build, maintain and optimise automated customer programs in Bloomreach. As Specialist, Lifecycle Programs, you will translate approved strategies, briefs and playbooks into reliable CRM customer journeys in Bloomreach. You will work closely with the Lifecycle team, markets, Analytics, Digital & Technology and external partners to deliver high-quality lifecycle programs consistently and at scale.

**What You Will Do

**Together with the team, you will help turn our lifecycle strategy into high-quality, scalable customer experiences in Bloomreach. Your focus will be hands-on CRM implementation, quality execution and continuous optimisation.

**Build and deliver lifecycle programs

**

• Translate approved briefs and playbooks into segmentation, targeting and Bloomreach scenario setups.

• Build, deploy and maintain automated lifecycle programs across email and other relevant CRM channels.

• Support the rollout and localisation of lifecycle initiatives across markets.

**Ensure quality and optimise performance

**

• Test scenarios end to end and ensure they follow agreed templates, QA standards, contact strategy and suppression rules.

• Monitor live programs, troubleshoot implementation issues and contribute to clear documentation and handovers.

• Use performance insights and test results to improve targeting, timing, messaging and journey logic.

**Collaborate and share expertise

**

• Work closely with Lifecycle colleagues, markets, Analytics, Digital & Technology and external partners to deliver programs effectively.

• Provide hands-on Bloomreach support and share reusable solutions and learnings across the team.

• Contribute to improving templates, documentation and ways of working.

**What Success Looks Like

**

• Accurate and reliable lifecycle implementations.

• Consistent use of agreed standards, templates and QA controls.

• Faster and more efficient delivery across markets.

• Clear documentation and effective handovers.

• Improved customer engagement, conversion, lifecycle progression and repeat-purchase outcomes.

**To succeed in this role, you have

**

• Typically 2-4 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing or marketing automation.

• Practical hands-on experience with Bloomreach Engagement or a comparable marketing automation platform.

• Experience building automated customer journeys and applying segmentation, targeting and audience logic.

• An understanding of testing, QA and lifecycle program optimisation.

• Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation.

• The ability to collaborate effectively across business, technology, markets and external partners.

• The judgement to recognise and escalate complex implementation or governance questions.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken.

**Why join us?

**You will join Pandora’s global Customer Lifecycle & Membership team and help turn lifecycle strategy into customer experiences that can be scaled across markets.

The role gives you the opportunity to develop deep hands-on Bloomreach expertise, contribute to global lifecycle programs and help improve the standards, templates and ways of working that support our continued growth.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band 5B

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Head of P&O for Louis Nielsen
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating an exceptional employee experience and enabling business performance? Then this could be your next opportunity at Louis Nielsen and Specsavers.

Join us as our new Head of P&O for Louis Nielsen and take responsibility for a people agenda spanning two distinct parts of our business: our Support Office and our nationwide retail organisation. As a trusted business partner to the Country Leadership Team, you'll help shape organisational success by translating people priorities into meaningful business outcomes while leading a skilled, supportive and caring P&O team.

Your role

As Head of P&O, you will lead the local P&O team and people agenda for Louis Nielsen in Denmark. The role has two important dimensions.

For our Support Office, you will work closely with the Country Director and management team as a strategic P&O partner. You will help shape the organisation, leadership and employee experience needed to deliver the business plan, including organisational change, talent and performance, recruitment and onboarding, leadership development and engagement.

For our Retail organisation, you will ensure that the P&O team provides relevant and effective support to our stores and retail leaders. This includes strengthening the P&O services, processes and guidance available to stores, particularly within employee relations, employee experience and core people processes.

Across both areas, you will lead and develop the local P&O team, including payroll and connect Louis Nielsen with the wider Northern Europe P&O organisation, translating regional and global priorities into locally relevant delivery.

Your key responsibilities

Partnering with our Support Office:

• Partner with the Country Director and management team to shape and deliver the people agenda and local business plan.

• Advise and coach leaders on organisation, leadership, talent, performance and people-related matters.

• Lead organisational change and support leaders and colleagues through change.

• Ensure strong recruitment and onboarding, talent and performance processes, and development planning across the Support Office.

• Drive employee engagement, including Great Place to Work, action planning and follow-up.

Enabling our Retail organisation:

• Ensure that retail leaders and stores have access to relevant and effective P&O services and support.

• Support the continued development and delivery of HR services to stores, including employee relations and employee experience guidance.

• Ensure that core people processes and policies are practical, consistent and effective within our retail environment.

• Work closely with retail leadership to identify emerging people needs and translate them into appropriate P&O solutions.

Leading P&O and connecting with Northern Europe:

• Lead and develop the local P&O team, including payroll, creating clarity, capability and strong delivery.

• Represent Denmark within the Northern Europe P&O team and contribute to the Northern Europe People Plan.

• Translate relevant regional and global people priorities into strong local delivery.

• Partner with regional P&O colleagues across business partnering, learning and development, and operational excellence.

• Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects in Denmark and across Northern Europe.

Your new team

You'll lead the Danish People & Organisation team of six people while being part of the wider Northern Europe P&O function.

The team supports two distinct parts of Louis Nielsen: our Support Office and our nationwide retail organisation. The nature of that support differs, and an important part of your role will be ensuring that our P&O model meets the needs of both.

Within the Support Office, the team works closely with leaders and colleagues across the full employee lifecycle. For Retail, the focus is on providing scalable, effective P&O services, processes and guidance that enable our retail leaders and stores to succeed. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across the Northern Europe P&O function.

What are we looking for?

“We are looking for someone who genuinely cares about our people, builds trust, and understands everyday life in our stores and Support Office. Someone who offers practical support and keeps things simple and efficient, freeing up time for meaningful conversations, development and looking ahead. You’ll help shape the people agenda in Denmark—and I look forward to working alongside you and our colleagues across Northern Europe, sharing ideas and supporting one another.”_

- Malene Green Brostrøm, People Director Northern Europe

Preferably our candidates will have some of the following competencies:

• Significant HR leadership experience within a complex, matrix organisation.

• Experience acting as a strategic People partner to senior business leaders.

• Experience balancing strategic business partnering with the delivery of scalable and effective HR services across different employee populations.

• A strong track record of leading organisational change and transformation initiatives.

• Experience linking business strategy, people priorities, and employee engagement outcomes.

• Experience working within an international environment.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and influencing skills.

• Strong leadership experience with a proven ability to develop high-performing teams.

• The ability to move comfortably between strategic business partnering and ensuring strong, pragmatic P&O delivery.

It would be an advantage if you have:

• Experience within retail, consumer goods, or other customer-facing multi-site environments.

• Experience working across multiple countries or markets.

• Knowledge of employment relations and organisational change programmes.

• Experience leading cross-functional projects in an international organisation.

As a person, we believe that you are:

• An inspiring leader who develops and motivates others.

• A trusted advisor who builds credibility and strong relationships at all levels.

• Commercially minded and able to connect people priorities with business performance.

• Structured and resilient, with the ability to navigate complexity and change.

• A collaborative communicator who engages stakeholders across functions and geographies.

What awaits you upon joining Louis Nielsen

At Louis Nielsen and Specsavers, you'll get more than just a job. You'll join an organisation with a clear purpose: changing lives through better sight and hearing.

We offer an exciting and influential leadership role where you'll play a key part in shaping the future of our people agenda in Denmark.

Joining us, you’ll get:

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• Significant exposure to senior business leaders and strategic decision-making.

• An international and collaborative work environment.

• The chance to make a meaningful impact on both people and business performance.

• A culture built on trust, inclusion, and continuous development.

Your base will be at Louis Nielsen’s Support Office in Aalborg, but we take a very flexible approach to where you work. Finding the right person matters more to us than where in Denmark you live. You should, however, expect to spend a couple of days in Aalborg each week.

Is this your next step? Then apply today

To apply, please send us your CV using the button below. We want to respect your time, so including an application letter is optional. Feel free to apply as soon as possible. Please avoid including any photos or references to your age in your CV. It contributes to a fairer and more unbiased assessment.

We review CVs and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. Our recruitment process typically consists of an initial screening, two rounds of interviews, and a personality assessment feedback session.

Diversity & Inclusion at Specsavers

Specsavers will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected factor.

In line with our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we integrate these principles into all aspects of our work, from product development to team building.

About Celvivo

Celvivo is a Danish life science company developing innovative solutions for growing and studying cells in 3D while mimicking in vivo conditions. Our platform brings together advanced laboratory equipment and cloud-based software, helping researchers explore new possibilities in cell culture and achieve new results in their scientific research and their work towards better patient outcomes.

Celvivo has a team of 35 employees across Denmark, the United States, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UAE, and Singapore.

As we expand our presence within the pharmaceutical industry, we are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Director of Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs to establish and lead our quality and regulatory journey.

The Opportunity

You will play a central role in preparing Celvivo for increased engagement with pharmaceutical customers, ensuring that our quality systems, certifications, product compliance practices, and regulatory approach support both current and future business objectives.

You will report directly to our CEO and serve as a key member of the management team, defining and implementing Celvivo’s quality and regulatory strategy. Initially, you will be a hands-on leader working closely with external consultants to establish the foundations of the QA/RA function. As the company grows, you will build and develop the QA/RA agenda and capabilities required to support our future ambitions.

This is a unique opportunity to work with a premium product and shape the quality and regulatory strategy at an ambitious growth company, where your decisions will directly influence our future direction, customer relationships, and market opportunities.

What You Will Do

Quality & Regulatory Strategy

• Define Celvivo’s quality and regulatory roadmap, including recommendations regarding certifications, regulatory positioning, and quality investments.

• Advise executive management on strategic quality and regulatory decisions.

• Develop budgets and implementation plans for QA/RA initiatives.

Quality Management System & Certification

• Lead the implementation of a scalable Quality Management System.

• Establish SOP frameworks and key quality processes.

• Drive certification activities and ensure ongoing compliance.

Regulatory Affairs & Product Compliance

• Determine product classifications across key markets, including the EU and US.

• Ensure compliance of product claims, labeling, marketing materials, and CE marking activities.

• Monitor regulatory developments relevant to Celvivo and our customers.

Customer & Supplier Quality

• Serve as the primary quality contact for customers.

• Lead customer and supplier audits.

• Establish and maintain quality agreements with distributors, suppliers, and customers.

• Ensure audit readiness across the organization.

Leadership & Business Partnership

• Collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to create a pragmatic and effective quality culture.

• Maintain external and internal key stakeholders.

• Contribute actively to the management team and overall company strategy.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

• 

• Complete a comprehensive gap analysis and recommend Celvivo’s future quality and regulatory path.

• Deliver an approved QA/RA roadmap and budget.

• Establish the SOP framework and document product classifications.

• Implement core QMS processes and prepare the company for certification.

• Develop a scalable resource plan for the future QA/RA organization

What You Bring

We imagine that you bring:

• 

• An MSc or equivalent degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• More than 10 years of QA/RA experience within life science tools, medical devices, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical environments.

• A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.

• Experience implementing ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 compliant quality management systems, ideally from the ground up.

• Experience driving certification activities and interacting with auditors.

• Strong knowledge of product classification, labeling, and compliance requirements for laboratory equipment and related technologies.

• Experience working with pharmaceutical customers and quality audits is highly advantageous.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Danish is considered a plus

Why Join Celvivo?

At Celvivo you have the right to be nerdy, the obligation to be friendly, the chance to be pioneering and the privilege of working with premium products. We combine scientific curiosity with entrepreneurial ambition, and we are united by our mission to help researchers achieve better outcomes through smarter ways of working.

As Director of QA/RA, you will have a rare opportunity to create a function from the ground up and make a tangible impact on Celvivo’s future growth and success together with a team of passionate colleagues.

Interested? Send us your CV and a cover letter with a few words about yourself, your experience, and what motivates you to join Celvivo.
